title: Publish a new article
description: An authenticated user can create a new article with an image and publish it successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to manage articles

Select a category for the article

Upload a valid image file
Publish the article
Verify the article is published
